title: Reduced bi-atrial reservoir strain in patients with cardiac amyloidosis: a cardiac magnetic resonance feature-tracking study

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Reduced bi-atrial reservoir strain in patients with cardiac amyloidosis: a cardiac magnetic resonance feature-tracking study》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Background · abstract-1-1】Although heart strain analysis is useful for diagnosing cardiac amyloidosis (CA), it remains unclear which chamber best distinguishes CA from hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM). This study analyzed strain in all four cardiac chambers in patients with CA and HCM using cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) feature-tracking.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Reduced bi-atrial reservoir strain in patients with cardiac amyloidosis: a cardiac magnetic resonance feature-tracking study》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Methods · abstract-2-1】We enrolled 30 patients with left ventricular hypertrophy (15 with CA and 15 with HCM) and 17 healthy volunteers as a reference. Participants underwent 1.5-Tesla CMR to assess volume, function, and strain parameters in both ventricles and atria. The primary analysis comprised four comparisons between CA and HCM, one representative parameter per chamber (bi-ventricular longitudinal strain and bi-atrial reservoir strain), with Bonferroni correction (P < 0.0125). Additionally, exploratory analyses of the other parameters were conducted comparing patients with CA to HCM.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Reduced bi-atrial reservoir strain in patients with cardiac amyloidosis: a cardiac magnetic resonance feature-tracking study》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Results · abstract-3-1】Left atrial (LA) and right atrial (RA) reservoir strain were lower in CA than in HCM (LA: 7.1 ± 4.1% vs. 10.3 ± 3.9%, P = 0.035; RA: 10.8 ± 6.9% vs. 22.1 ± 12.9%, P = 0.005), whereas ventricular longitudinal strain did not differ. After Bonferroni correction, only RA reservoir strain remained significant. In an exploratory receiver operating characteristic analysis, the areas under the curve for LA and RA reservoir strain were 0.73 and 0.78, respectively, and did not differ significantly.

【Conclusion · abstract-4-1】Bi-atrial reservoir strain was lower in CA than in HCM, and the difference in RA reservoir strain remained significant after accounting for multiplicity. Atrial reservoir strain may provide adjunctive, contrast-free functional information to help differentiate CA from HCM.
